title: Compute Desk, which is building capital markets infrastructure to price, trade, hedge, and clear compute, raised a $45M seed led by Lightspeed
html:

summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios : Compute Desk, which is building capital markets infrastructure to price, trade, hedge, and clear compute, raised a $45M seed led by Lightspeed — Compute Desk, a startup aiming to make compute an asset that can be traded and hedged, raised $45 million in a Lightspeed Venture Pa
